description: Conectividad pública gratuita a internet. Bogotá D.C. is a dataset listed in City of Bogotá open data portal (Datos Abiertos Bogotá), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría General de la Alcaldía Mayor de Bogotá - SGAMB. Muestra la infraestructura, espacios y modalidades de acceso gratuito a internet auspiciados por el Distrito Capital a través de diferentes entidades y programas. El acceso se puede hacer a través de redes WiFi en el espacio público o en otros espacios acondicionados con equipos de cómputo y herramientas para adelantar procesos de formación. Coverage: Bogotá. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría General de la Alcaldía Mayor de Bogotá - SGAMB. Its tags are INTERNET, Plan nacional de conectividad, Zona WiFi Gratuita, conectividad, infraestructura TIC. It offers 9 resource(s) in DXF, ESRI REST, GEOJSON, GPKG, HTML. The portal shows 2026-05-13 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bogota-portal.
